newsitem.title: USA: DLB Oil to buy Bonray for $30/shr.
newsitem.headline: DLB Oil to buy Bonray for $30/shr.

text.p: DLB Oil & Gas Inc signed a definitive agreement to buy Bonray Drilling Corp for $30 per share in cash, the two companies said.
Under terms of the deal, Bonray will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of DLB Oil. DLB will make a cash tender offer for all of the outstanding Bonray common stock.
Shareholders owning about 54 percent of outstanding Bonray stock agreed to tender their shares pursuant to the offer, the companies said.
The transaction has been unanimously approved by the boards of both companies.

"We consider this merger to be a positive step towards insuring DLB's access to drilling rigs and enhancing Bonray's rig utilization," said Mike Liddell, DLB chief executive. "We expect that the management and employees of Bonray will continue with the combined companies."
Bonray currently owns 15 land rigs in Oklahoma, which have depth capabilities ranging from 7,000 to 25,000 feet.
DLB is an Oklahoma City-based company engaged in crude oil and natural gas exploration and development.
